limits: Generated saves and isolated browser contexts only; personal saves and previous preview origins untouched.
The visible review uses an already earned generated discovery and generated higher native skill XP; it is not proof of natural training progression.

New physical transformations, recovery/aging rules, bloodline progression and NPC recognition remain proposals.
Full native responsive redesign and human wording, placement and ease-of-use acceptance remain pending.
